title: Ponmanam
desc: An unemployed Anandhan's family has no expectations from him. However, when his parents commit suicide after his sister elopes, he is determined to find her.

title: Vigneshwar
desc: A young man starts to drive a taxi in order to earn a livelihood. He crosses paths with a mysterious man but is oblivious to the fact that he is a ruthless killer.

title: Namma Ooru Ellaiamman
desc: Renuka Devi is a widow who finds herself facing several hardships and struggles in her life. However, she never loses hope and keeps trying to find her way out.

title: Rhythm
desc: Karthikeyan, a photo editor in Mumbai, is a widower whose parents wish to see him settled and happy. Chitra, a widow with a son, gives them hope, unaware that their pasts are intertwined.

title: Tik Tik Tik
desc: Dileep, a photographer, gets involved with three models, Sharadha, Radha and Swapna. When they start dying mysteriously one after another, Dileep becomes a suspect.
